name: Kanan's Jedi holocron

fate.text: A shard hangs on the Syndulla kalikori; the rest is unrecorded.

summary: A Jedi holocron Depa Billaba gives her Padawan as the Clone Wars end. Kanan stores Obi-Wan's warning in it; Ezra pockets it and opens it, and Maul later forces its fusion with a Sith holocron, which damages both.

custody.note: Owned by the Council member, who wants her Padawan to study questioning and dissent.
Loads Kenobi's warning to surviving Jedi into it after Order 66.

name: The Malachor Sith holocron

fate.text: Cracked in the fusion; last seen at Chopper Base, later fate unrecorded.

summary: An ancient Sith holocron hidden in the temple on Malachor, able to arm its superweapon. Ezra takes it out with Maul's help and grows drawn to it; Kanan leaves it with the Bendu, and Maul later demands it for a fusion that damages it.

custody.note: Hidden under the temple after the ancient Jedi–Sith battle there.

custody.record: Twilight of the Apprentice
custody.note: Pulls it from a Sith altar with Maul, later pries it from the obelisk with Kanan.

custody.record: Steps Into Shadow

name: The sacred Jedi texts

made.yText: undated; from the Jedi Order's dawn

fate.text: Kept by Rey once Palpatine falls, as of the latest canon.

summary: Eight ancient books and scrolls dating to the Jedi Order's beginnings. Luke gathers them across the galaxy and shelves them inside a hollow tree on Ahch-To; Rey quietly takes them aboard the Falcon and uses their lessons to mend her saber and chart a way to Exegol.

custody.note: Written by early sages such as Kli the Elder and Lyr Farseeker.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary

name: Vader's wayfinder

made.yText: undated; first held by the Eye of Webbish Bog

fate.text: Guides Rey to Exegol and gives the Resistance the route.

summary: One of two Sith wayfinders that chart the hidden route to Exegol. Mustafar's Eye of Webbish Bog gives it to Vader, who later returns it to the Eye's keeping on Mustafar. Kylo Ren takes it decades later, and Rey uses it to reach Palpatine.

custody.note: A Mustafar entity that holds the device before Vader arrives.
As Vader he uses it to learn what his master is doing on Exegol.
Vader leaves it in the Eye's care; Alazmec cultists guard Fortress Vader's ruins.
sources: Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition

name: The map to Peridea (Arcana Star Map)

fate.text: Cut apart by Baylan Skoll's lightsaber on Seatos.

summary: A golden orb from a Nightsister temple on Arcana that projects the path to Peridea. Ahsoka finds it, Sabine unlocks it, and Shin Hati's droid takes it for Morgan Elsbeth; on Seatos, Sabine hands it to Baylan Skoll for passage to Ezra, and Baylan destroys it.

custody.note: Sealed in a temple built by Morgan Elsbeth's Nightsister ancestors.
